name: Microsoft Edge
author: Microsoft
summary: Microsoft Edge is a cross-platform web browser built for modern life.
description:
Microsoft Edge is a cross-platform web browser created and developed by Microsoft.
It was first released for Windows 10 and Xbox One in 2015, for Android and iOS in 2017, for macOS in 2019, and for Linux in 2020.
